checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are 854x480 landscape, and the clip is 5 s.

must.item: Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons move slowly against a dark background
must.why: Blue/cyan and violet ribbons glow on a dark background, and they change position across frames.

must.item: Top third mostly dark, brightest ribbons lower down
must.why: Ribbons cross the top area and are bright there; the brightness is not concentrated low.

must.item: No visible jump at the loop boundary
must.why: The first and last frames differ clearly, and the assistant itself said the loop may jump.

must.item: No words or interface elements baked in
must.why: No text or UI is visible.
The assistant said the video has no sound. I could not check this from the frames.

faults.what: The video is landscape 16:9 at 480p and 5 s, not the 8 s portrait wallpaper the brief needs.
Bright ribbons fill the top of the frame, so the layout does not suit a wallpaper with a clean top area.
The clip is not made to loop, so a jump is likely when it restarts.

summary: The clip shows attractive glowing blue and violet ribbons on black, but it is a 5 s landscape 480p video that does not loop, and the ribbons are bright across the top, so it fails the portrait, loop and dark-top requirements.
